data.name: Electrical Leak
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "Electrical Leak"—a electrician simulation and electrical puzzle game adapted from real-world cases!

If you miss classic Flash room-escape games and are curious about the physics of real-world circuits, this game is the perfect choice for you. Armed with nothing but a test pen, you will face seemingly ordinary yet hazard-filled daily scenarios. The game features a pure, level-by-level progression system.

You will need rigorous logic and hardcore electrical knowledge to trace and identify the deadly source of leakage among tangled cables and malfunctioning appliances, and fix it with your own hands!

⚠️ One-Touch Fatality: The game enforces strict safety rules. If you fail to follow electrical safety protocols (such as working on live circuits without cutting the power), you might get electrocuted instantly, resulting in a Game Over!

Game Information at a Glance

  • Genre: Puzzle / Point-and-Click / Simulation / Physics Education

  • Playtime: Under 1 hour

  • Target Audience: Puzzle game enthusiasts, STEM students, DIY hobbyists, physics teachers, and everyday citizens who want to understand household electricity.
